text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now then. That should be enough walking 
for now... ...Oh?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Ow ow ow... H-Hey there, dear, could you 
give me a hand...? I took a spill on my 
way back from shopping...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
!? Well... here, please. Hold onto me. 
I'll see you all the way home.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
"—Well now, thank you kindly. Would you 
like to come inside for a cup of tea?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll take you up on that. However, 
before that, we must tend to your injuries 
just to be safe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Do you have any bandages or the like? 
Also, if it is all right, I could borrow 
the kitchen to prepare some medicinal 
herbal cuisine—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
No, no, young lady, you really don't have 
to go that far for us—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. ...I simply cannot leave someone 
who is feeling unwell on their own.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And perhaps because she worked too hard 
helping others... Mejiro Ardan looked a 
little worn out.
